newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police raid 150 homes of people living illegally in Jeddah, arrest owners.
- King Fahd receives message from Yemeni president.
- YANBET secures underwriters for $2.32 billion loan to finance expansion.
- Mobile phone service to Indonesia restored after a two-week suspension.
- Ten real estate offices run by expatriates closed down.
- Health minister signs contracts worth 957 million riyals to run hospitals in Mecca and Asir areas with a local firm.
- Saudi Agricultural Bank extended 22 loans worth 5.2 million riyals in the first half of 1997.
- Saudi Industry Ministry approves the setting up of a 514 million riyal ammonia project in the industrial city of Jubail.
- Saudi businessman Prince Al-Waleed invests $10 million in the Palestine Investment and Development Company.
